label: Judgment and decision-making
description: Research on probabilistic judgement, choice under uncertainty, heuristics and decision quality.

label: Social psychology
description: Research on attribution, attitudes, identity, interpersonal judgement and social influence.

label: Memory and cognition
description: Research on attention, learning, reasoning, remembering and information processing.

label: Perception and psychophysics
description: Research on perceptual salience, discrimination, magnitude and the relation between stimuli and experience.

label: Behavioral economics
description: Research joining psychological evidence to economic accounts of value, markets and intertemporal choice.

label: Clinical and medical reasoning
description: Research on judgement, diagnosis, risk communication and decision-making in health contexts.

label: Organizational and communication research
description: Research on institutions, management, media selection, public discourse and collective decisions.

label: Popular or weakly formalized terminology
description: Labels common in applied or public discussion whose independent scientific status is limited or unsettled.
